blind.B1: Yes. Untrained pre-menopausal females, 12-week resistance training, vastus lateralis biopsies PRE and POST (S2.11, S3.6; GEO treatment_protocol). Every sequenced sample (PRE and POST) carries the exercise factor as a time contrast; no non-exercise arm.
blind.B2: One comparison: POST vs PRE training. Fig 7 legend (FIG7): n = 35 pre-training, 27 post-training (27 participants completed, S2.2/Table 2). GEO holds 31 PRE / 26 POST (57 libraries), so 4 PRE and 1 POST are not in GEO.
blind.B3: Yes. Same participant is biopsied before and after training. The sample title is a 4-letter participant code plus PRE/POST (e.g. ALORPRE/ALORPOST); 24 codes have both timepoints, 7 PRE-only, 2 POST-only. Packet A lists no candidate key (the title prefix is not auto-detected), but the paper states it (S2.14.p6: ID accounts for repeated measurements).
blind.B4: One joint model on all samples: 'Differential gene analysis was conducted using the R package DeSeq2 using the model: Genes~ID+timepoint. ID was used to account for repeated measurements.' (S2.14.p6)
blind.B5: 'We considered genes and transcription factors significant with a false discovery rate (FDR) adjusted P-value <0.05' (S2.14.p7); no fold-change cutoff. Reported: 214 transcripts, 122 up, 92 down (S3.6.p1, FIG7); 14,979 genes after filtering (S2.12.6.p1).

time: PRE 31 / POST 26 from characteristics_ch1.4.treatment, equals title suffix; deviation from paper's 35/27 is recorded (missing GEO samples), no exclusions.

summary: 该系列确为运动(抗阻训练 PRE/POST)研究,分组、方向、阈值、矩阵类型均与论文一致。但论文模型为 DESeq2 ~ ID + timepoint,而分析虽已从标题派生出 subject 列(24 名受试者有前后配对),实际执行的却是 ~ time,协变量步骤误判为无需分块,导致 DEG 仅 79 个(论文 214)且 paper_route 被标为已复现。需要按 ~ subject + time 重跑并更新对比。
